keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «외계인은 괴물이 아니라 외로운 아이였다(사건)» 와 «친구는 생각지도 못한 곳에서 만날 수 있다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the event (the alien was not a monster but a lonely kid) and the lesson (a friend can be found in the most surprising places). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Juno, his sister Ara, Zuri the alien

opts: He thought aliens might attack them.
The radio broke in the garage.
evs: They wrote down the beeps for three nights.
Juno was scared. "What if aliens attack us?"
Juno and his sister Ara built a radio in the garage.
Every night after that, the three friends talked across the stars.
why: 주노는 «외계인이 우리를 공격하면 어떡해?» 하고 무서워했어요. 라디오가 고장 났다거나 아라가 화를 냈다는 말은 없어요.
Juno was scared and said, «What if aliens attack us?» Nothing says the radio broke or that Ara was angry.

qs.q: The story says, "But the next message changed everything." What does "changed everything" mean here?
qs.qko: "But the next message changed everything."라는 문장이 있어요. 여기서 "changed everything"은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: made them see the alien in a new way
evs: The alien was not a monster. It was a lonely kid, just like them!
Late one night, it made a strange sound: beep, beep-beep, beep.
The signal was coming from far beyond the Moon!
They wrote down the beeps for three nights.
why: 다음 메시지를 받고 나서 외계인이 괴물이 아니라 외로운 아이라는 걸 알게 되었어요. 무서운 마음이 친구가 되고 싶은 마음으로 바뀐 거예요.
After the next message, they learned the alien was not a monster but a lonely kid. Their fear turned into friendship.

qs.q: Why did Ara say, "Now you have two friends on Earth"?
qs.qko: 아라는 왜 "Now you have two friends on Earth."라고 말했나요?
opts: Zuri had no friends on that planet.
Zuri asked for a new radio.
evs: "I am Zuri. I am ten years old. I have no friends on my planet."
Juno was scared. "What if aliens attack us?"
The alien was not a monster. It was a lonely kid, just like them!
Late one night, it made a strange sound: beep, beep-beep, beep.
why: 주리는 «우리 행성에는 친구가 없어»라고 했고, 둘과 같은 외로운 아이였어요. 그래서 아라가 친구가 되어 주겠다고 답한 거예요.
Zuri said there were no friends on that planet, and Zuri was a lonely kid just like them. So Ara answered that they would be friends.

ends: Zuri visits Earth and meets Juno and Ara.
주리가 지구에 와서 주노와 아라를 직접 만나요.
Juno and Ara build a bigger radio to talk with more planets.
주노와 아라가 더 큰 라디오를 만들어 다른 행성들과도 이야기해요.

write.src: “I think <u>the alien is not scary</u> because <u>it is a lonely kid</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because it has no friends)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because it has no friends)

img.cover: At night in a messy garage, a ten-year-old Korean boy with short spiky black hair, round black glasses, a yellow hoodie and blue jeans and his older sister, a twelve-year-old Korean girl with a long black ponytail, a purple T-shirt and gray overalls lean over a homemade radio with blinking lights and a tall wire antenna, smiling and talking into a small microphone; through the open garage door, a sky full of stars shows a tiny purple planet where a small round green alien kid with big shiny black eyes, two short antennae and a little orange scarf waves back.

scenes.1: Late at night in the garage, a ten-year-old Korean boy with short spiky black hair, round black glasses, a yellow hoodie and blue jeans and his older sister, a twelve-year-old Korean girl with a long black ponytail, a purple T-shirt and gray overalls sit by a homemade radio with blinking lights; she draws rows of small dots and short lines in a notebook while he points through the window at a bright full Moon.
scenes.2: A split picture: on the left, in the dark garage, a ten-year-old Korean boy with short spiky black hair, round black glasses, a yellow hoodie and blue jeans hides behind his older sister, a twelve-year-old Korean girl with a long black ponytail, a purple T-shirt and gray overalls with wide scared eyes while the homemade radio glows; on the right, far away on a tiny purple planet, a small round green alien kid with big shiny black eyes, two short antennae and a little orange scarf sits alone on a rock, holding a little radio and looking sad.

alt.1: Two kids write down beeps from the radio at night.
alt.2: A scared boy hides while a lonely alien kid sits on a far planet.
